therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Participants with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective Response Rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1

results.effect_size: ORR varied by cohort: 37.5% (cervical), 25% (uveal melanoma), 20% (endometrial CPI-naive), 16.7% (UPS), 10% (ovarian, de-diff LPS), 0% (HNSCC, TMB-H MSS, other sarcoma, GCT, endometrial post-CPI)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Etigilimab serum concentrations: 262 μg/mL (15 min post-infusion C1D1), 20.1 μg/mL (pre-infusion C4D43), 273 μg/mL (15 min post-infusion C4D43)
subgroup_findings: Cervical carcinoma showed highest ORR at 37.5%
Endometrial cancer post-CPI treatment showed 0% ORR vs 20% in CPI-naive
TMB-H + MSS solid tumors showed 0% ORR despite biomarker selection
safety_signals: Immune-related adverse events in 8 participants across cohorts
Serious infections including pneumonia, sepsis, septic shock
results.dose_information: IV infusion every 2 weeks for both etigilimab and nivolumab
